judgments.reason: No model text explains that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that bids above coins win; trace shows no payment/commission ordering or a bid exceeding coins.

The hypothesis claims waiting reveals already committed rival bids before you commit; focal P1 committed first. The model only states it will wait after committing and does not articulate the mechanism of gaining uncommitted rivals' sealed values prior to committing.

Specification claims close can settle with unauctioned lots; the transcript shows normal resolution only after all committed and no early settlement discrepancy, and the model never articulates an early-settlement mechanism.
No model articulation or trace indicates catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; the model never claims or demonstrates commission applying to buys.
